description.value: Damso is a modern Korean restaurant operated by Damso Group, offering an all-you-can-eat Korean menu with dishes like Korean BBQ, pork belly, tteokbokki, and Korean fried chicken. The restaurant is card-only and uses a waitlist seating system. Online ordering is available for takeout.
